name: Lat Pulldown
cue: Set the scaps first. Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down, not behind the body.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
cue: Set the scaps, then pull the handle to the upper chest. Elbows stay in; don’t lean way back.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cue: Wide grip, scaps set. Pull to the upper chest with elbows down, not behind the body.

name: Pull-Up
cue: Dead hang to chin over the bar. Drive elbows down; avoid kipping unless that’s the point.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
cue: Set the counterweight so the last rep or two is hard, not free. Dead hang to chin over the bar.

name: Chin-Up
cue: Supinated grip. Same full range as a pull-up, with a little more biceps.

name: Barbell Row
cue: Hinge, brace, and row to the lower ribs. Don’t turn it into a shrug or a deadlift.

name: Landmine Row
cue: Hinge, brace, and row the bar to the hip. Don’t yank with the torso or turn it into a shrug.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cue: Chest stays on the pad. Row the elbows back and squeeze; don’t yank from the neck.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cue: Drive the chest into the pad. Pull toward the lower ribs and lower under control; don’t bounce.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue: Hinge, brace, and row the elbow to the hip. Don’t rotate the torso to cheat the last inches.

name: One-Arm Cable Row
cue: Start from a long arm. Pull the elbow back, pause, then reach without rounding hard.

name: Machine Row
cue: Chest on the pad, set the shoulder blades, then pull the handles to the ribs. Pause and control the stretch; don’t yank with the lower back.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue: Start from a long arm. Pull elbows back, pause, then reach forward without rounding hard.

name: Inverted Row
cue: Body straight from a bar or rings, chest to the bar. Keep the hips up; don’t let them sag.

name: Back Squat
cue: Brace before you descend. Sit between the hips, keep mid-foot pressure, and stand without collapsing the chest.

name: Front Squat
cue: Elbows high, torso tall. The bar stays over mid-foot as you sit down and drive up.

name: Zercher Squat
cue: Hold the bar in the elbow crook and keep a tall torso. Brace, sit between the hips, and stand without folding forward.

name: Hack Squat
cue: Back against the pad, feet planted. Descend with control and stand without locking out aggressively.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cue: Brace and sit between the hips. Keep mid-foot pressure; don’t collapse the chest or ride the bar forward.

name: Belt Squat
cue: Load the hips, not the spine. Sit down and stand tall; don’t let the torso fold.

name: Sissy Squat
cue: Knees travel forward as the hips stay relatively high. Control the descent; don’t dump into the low back.

name: Reverse Squat
cue: Drive the knees up against the load without dumping the pelvis. Control the return; don’t swing.

name: Landmine Squat
cue: Hold the bar at chest height and sit between the hips. Brace, stay tall, and stand without folding forward.

name: Box Squat
cue: Sit back to the box under control, pause briefly, then drive up without rocking forward.

name: Goblet Squat
cue: Hold the weight at chest height. Sit between the hips and keep the elbows inside the knees.

name: Safety Bar Squat
cue: Set the yoke on your back and brace. Sit between the hips and drive up without folding forward.

name: Pendulum Squat
cue: Shoulders under the pads, feet planted. Sit deep along the arc with control and drive up without locking out hard.

name: Leg Press
cue: Full foot on the platform. Lower with control and stop before the low back rounds.

name: Cossack Squat
cue: Shift side to side with one leg extended. Keep the working heel down and chest as tall as you can.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Most of the load on the front leg. Slight forward lean is fine; keep the front knee tracking over the toes.

name: Zercher Split Squat
cue: Bar in the elbow crook, most of the load on the front leg. Stay tall; keep the front knee tracking over the toes.

name: Step-Up
cue: Drive through the whole foot on the box. Stand tall; don’t push off the trailing leg. Use a big box.

name: Zercher Step-Up
cue: Bar in the elbow crook, drive through the whole foot on the box. Stand tall; don’t push off the trailing leg.

name: Walking Lunge
cue: Long enough stride to load the glute. Front knee tracks the toes; trail knee drops under the hip.

name: Zercher Lunge
cue: Hold the bar in the elbow crook and stay tall. Long enough stride to load the glute; front knee tracks the toes.

name: Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back far enough to load the front glute. Front knee tracks the toes; don’t crash the trail knee.

name: Zercher Reverse Lunge
cue: Hold the bar in the elbow crook. Step back far enough to load the front glute; stay tall through the torso.

name: Forward Lunge
cue: Step forward and drop the trail knee under the hip. Front knee tracks; don’t slam into the bottom.

name: Pistol Squat
cue: Balance on one leg, extend the other forward. Sit as deep as you can control and stand without collapsing.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
cue: Hips stay extended as you lower. Pull back with the hamstrings; don’t pike or fold at the waist.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cue: Soft knees, push the hips back, bar close to the legs. Stop when the hamstrings run out of range.

name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
cue: Hinge at the hip over one leg, trailing leg reaching back for balance. Keep the hips square and the weight close.

name: Deadlift
cue: Wedge in, brace, and push the floor away. The bar stays over mid-foot from floor to lockout.

name: Zercher Deadlift
cue: Bar in the elbow crook from the floor. Brace, then stand tall without losing the torso.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cue: Wide stance, toes turned out. Push the knees out, wedge in, and keep the bar over mid-foot.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cue: Stand inside the handles, hinge and grip. Push the floor away and stand tall without rounding the back.

name: Rack Pull
cue: Set the bar at knee height or above. Brace, then drive the hips forward to lockout without hyperextending.

name: Deficit Deadlift
cue: Stand on a plate or platform. Wedge in from the deeper start, brace, and pull with the bar over mid-foot.

name: Good Morning
cue: Brace, then hinge until the hamstrings stop you. Bar stays over mid-foot; don’t round the back.

name: Seated Good Morning
cue: Sit tall, then hinge and pull with the posterior chain. Brace; don’t round through the low back to finish.

name: Jefferson Curl
cue: Hold the bar in the hands and round the spine slowly from the neck down. Reverse with control; don’t bounce out of the bottom.

name: Zercher Jefferson Curl
cue: Bar in the elbow crook. Round the spine slowly vertebra by vertebra, then reverse with control; don’t rush the flexion.

name: Back Extension
cue: Hinge at the hips, not the spine. Rise until the body is in line; don’t hyperextend the low back.

name: Reverse Hyper
cue: Hips on the pad, swing the legs with the glutes. Stop in line with the torso; don’t hyperextend the low back.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue: Hinge hard, then snap the hips to float the bell to chest height. Keep the arms loose; don’t squat the swing or lift with the shoulders.

name: Hip Thrust
cue: Chin tucked, ribs down. Finish with a hard glute squeeze and a flat torso at the top.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, ribs down. Drive the bar up with the glutes and finish with a flat torso at the top.

name: Barbell Curl
cue: Elbows close. No swing. Squeeze at the top and lower for 2–3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cue: Supinate through the lift. Keep the upper arm still.

name: Hammer Curl
cue: Neutral grip. Control both directions; this is also a forearm builder.

name: Preacher Curl
cue: Upper arms pinned to the pad. Curl through a full range and lower slowly; don’t hyperextend the elbows.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
cue: Upper arms pinned to the pad. Curl through a full range and lower slowly; don’t hyperextend the elbows.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Let the arms hang. Curl without swinging, and keep the shoulders from rolling forward.

name: Cable Curl
cue: Elbows close, constant tension. Squeeze at the top and don’t lean back to finish.

name: Concentration Curl
cue: Elbow braced. Curl to the shoulder and lower fully; no body English.

name: Spider Curl
cue: Chest on the bench, arms hanging. Curl without swinging; control the stretch at the bottom.

name: Reverse Curl
cue: Pronated grip, elbows close. Curl without swinging; this loads the forearms too.

name: Shoulder External Rotation
cue: Elbow pinned at your side, bent 90°. Rotate the forearm outward with light load; don’t shrug or let the elbow drift.

name: Cable Pullover
cue: Arms stay slightly bent. Sweep the handle down and in an arc over the hips; don’t turn it into a triceps pushdown.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
cue: Upper back supported, weight held with soft elbows. Lower behind the head for a stretch, then pull back over the chest.

name: Face Pull
cue: Pull toward the face, externally rotate at the end, and keep the ribs down.

name: Rear Delt Fly
cue: Hinge, soft elbows, and sweep the arms out. Stop at torso height; don’t yank with the traps.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cue: Hinge or stand tall with soft elbows. Sweep the handles out to the sides and squeeze the rear delts.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cue: Chest on the pad, soft elbows. Sweep out and squeeze the rear delts without shrugging.

name: Upright Row
cue: Lead with the elbows, bar close to the body. Stop around chest height; don’t yank the bar into the neck.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Stand tall and shrug straight up. Pause at the top; don’t roll the shoulders.

name: Barbell Shrug
cue: Brace, then shrug the bar straight up. Pause and lower; don’t roll or heave.

name: Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms supported, wrists hanging. Curl through a full range and don’t let the elbows take over.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms supported, palms down. Extend the wrists through a full range; keep it slow.

name: Hand Gripper
cue: Squeeze until the handles touch, then release under control. Keep the wrist neutral and elbow still. ## Legs

name: Barbell Bench Press
cue: Plant the feet, set the scaps, and lower to the chest with wrists stacked. Press back toward the rack.

name: Decline Bench Press
cue: Lock the legs under the pads and lower to the lower chest. Press up and slightly back toward the rack.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cue: Set the bar path over the nipple line. Lower under control and press without bouncing off the safety catches.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Set the scaps and keep a slight arch. Lower to the upper chest with control; don’t bounce or flare the elbows out wide.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue: 30–45° bench. Lower until the elbows are in line with the torso, then press without flaring wildly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Slight arch, dumbbells travel in a gentle arc. Control the bottom stretch.

name: Machine Press
cue: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest. Shoulder blades back, press smoothly, and don’t let the shoulders roll forward.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue: Brace and keep the shoulders packed. Press through a full range and stop short of locking out aggressively.

name: Dips
cue: Shoulders down. Lean forward for more chest; stay more upright for triceps. Don’t dump into the joints.

name: Dip Machine
cue: Set the seat so the handles line up under the shoulders. Lean forward for more chest; stay upright for triceps.

name: Push-Up
cue: Body in one line. Elbows ~45° from the torso. Chest to near the floor, then press the floor away.

name: Assisted Dip
cue: Log the assistance, not your weight: less assistance is harder. Shoulders down, lean forward for chest, and don’t dump into the joints.

name: Cable Fly
cue: Soft elbows, sweep in an arc, and squeeze without shrugging.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cue: Slight bend in the elbows and a wide arc. Stop when the chest is stretched; don’t turn it into a press.

name: Pec Deck
cue: Soft elbows, chest proud. Sweep until you feel a stretch, then squeeze without shrugging the shoulders.

name: Overhead Press
cue: Glutes tight, ribs stacked. Bar path close to the face; head through at the top.

name: Landmine Press
cue: Brace and press the bar up and slightly forward on an arc. Don’t over-arch the low back or let the shoulder dump forward.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Press slightly in front of the head. Don’t over-arch the low back.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue: Ribs down, glutes on. Press overhead without over-arching the low back.

name: Lateral Raise
cue: Lead with the elbows, slight lean, and stop around shoulder height. Control the lower.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cue: Lead with the elbows and keep tension through the whole arc. Stop around shoulder height; don’t swing.

name: Front Raise
cue: Raise to eye height with a slight elbow bend. Don’t use the low back to heave the weight up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Grip just inside shoulder width. Elbows stay tucked; lower to the chest and press without bouncing.

name: JM Press
cue: Elbows forward, bar travels down toward the upper chest. Press back without flaring the elbows wide.

name: Tricep Pushdown
cue: Elbows pinned by the sides. Full extension, then a controlled return.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cue: Elbows stay high and close. Extend fully, then control the stretch; don’t flare.

name: Skull Crusher
cue: Only the elbows move. Lower toward the forehead or hairline, then extend without flaring.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cue: Hips stay pinned to the pad. Curl through a full range and lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cue: Hips stay glued to the pad. Curl fully and lower without lifting the pelvis.

name: Nordic Curl
cue: Brace and lower as far as you can control. Catch with the hamstrings; don’t fold at the hips.

name: Leg Extension
cue: Control the top squeeze. Avoid slamming the stack; pause briefly at lockout.

name: Glute Kickback
cue: Square the hips and kick without arching the low back. Squeeze at the top; don’t swing.

name: Machine Hip Abduction
cue: Sit tall, then drive the knees out. Pause at the end range; don’t lean to cheat.

name: Machine Hip Adduction
cue: Sit tall and squeeze the thighs together. Control the return; don’t slam the stack.

name: Calf Raise
cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top. Knee position stays consistent.

name: Tibialis Raise
cue: Heels planted, lift the toes as high as you can. Pause at the top; don’t rock the torso.

name: Hip Internal Rotation
cue: Seated or lying, knee fixed. Rotate the lower leg outward so the thigh turns in at the hip. Slow and controlled, no pelvis shift.

name: Hip External Rotation
cue: Seated or lying, knee fixed. Rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns out at the hip. Keep the pelvis still. ## Explosive

name: Shoulder Internal Rotation
cue: Elbow pinned at your side, bent 90°. Rotate the forearm across the belly with light load; keep the shoulder down. ## Pull

name: Snatch
cue: Keep the bar close, then explode and punch under to lockout. Catch in a full squat with arms locked; don’t press it out.

name: Power Snatch
cue: Same pull as the snatch, catch higher. Bar close, explode, and punch under without riding into a deep squat.

name: Snatch Pull
cue: Pull like a snatch without going overhead. Bar close, explode through the hips, and finish tall; don’t lean back and yank.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
cue: Hike the bell, explode the hips, and punch through to lockout overhead. The bell should roll around the wrist, not slam onto it.

name: Clean
cue: Bar close off the floor, then explode and pull under to the front rack. Catch with elbows high; don’t crash the bar onto the shoulders.

name: Clean and Jerk
cue: Clean to a solid front rack, then dip and drive the bar overhead. Punch under the jerk and lock out; don’t press it out from the shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Clean
cue: Hinge and snap the hips, then guide the bell into a tight rack. Elbow close, wrist stacked; don’t let the bell crash onto the forearm.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
cue: Clean to a solid rack, then dip and drive the bell overhead. Punch under to lockout; don’t press it out from a stalled rack.

name: Box Jump
cue: Load the hips, then jump onto the box and land softly with the whole foot. Stand tall to finish; don’t rebound off a bouncing landing.

name: Kettlebell High Pull
cue: Hinge and explode the hips, then pull the bell to the chest with high elbows. Keep it close; don’t shrug it out in front of you.

name: Kettlebell Push Press
cue: Dip the knees slightly, then drive the bell overhead and finish with the arm. Use the legs to start the press; don’t turn it into a strict press. ## Core

name: Plank
cue: Ribs down, glutes on, neck long. Don’t sag or pike.

name: Ab Wheel
cue: Roll out only as far as you can keep a braced, slightly rounded torso. ---

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cue: Posteriorly tilt the pelvis and lift with the abs, not momentum.

name: Sit-Up
cue: Ribs toward the hips. Sit up without yanking on the neck or using momentum.

name: Cable Crunch
cue: Round the spine to shorten the abs. Hips stay relatively still.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
cue: Round the spine to shorten the abs rather than just pulling the handles down. Control the return.

name: Cable Woodchop
cue: Brace and rotate through the torso, not the arms. Control both directions; don’t twist from the knees.

name: Landmine Rotation
cue: Brace and rotate the bar through the torso, not the arms. Control both directions; don’t twist from the knees.

name: Russian Twist
cue: Lean back with feet up or grounded, rotate the torso side to side. Move slow; don’t just swing the arms.

name: Zercher Carry
cue: Hold the bar in the elbow crook and brace hard. Walk tall without leaning or letting the torso fold.

name: Farmer's Walk
cue: Brace hard and walk tall with the weights close to your sides. Don’t shrug or let the torso lean; short, quick steps.

name: Turkish Get-Up
cue: Press the bell up and keep your eyes on it through every step from floor to standing. Move slow and deliberate, not rushed.
